graphify/extractor.py.name: graphify.extractor
graphify/extractor.py.docstring:
AST Parser and repository scanner for Graphify.
Extracts module structure, classes, functions, docstrings, and import relationships
without importing or running arbitrary code.

graphify/extractor.py::ASTExtractor.name: ASTExtractor
graphify/extractor.py::ASTExtractor.docstring: AST Visitor that extracts structural metadata and dependencies from a single Python file.

graphify/extractor.py::_module_to_rel_pa.name: _module_to_rel_path
graphify/extractor.py::_module_to_rel_pa.docstring:
Converts a Python module dot-notation name to a relative file path in the repository.
Example: 'src.features.technical_indicators' -> 'src/features/technical_indicators.py'

graphify/extractor.py::extract_repositor.name: extract_repository_graph
graphify/extractor.py::extract_repositor.docstring:
Scans a Python repository directory, extracts AST metadata from all valid .py files,
and returns a consolidated KnowledgeGraph.

graphify/graph.py.name: graphify.graph
graphify/graph.py.docstring:
Knowledge Graph data structure and relational query engine for Graphify.
Stores AST nodes (modules, classes, functions) and directed edges (imports, defines, inherits),
with persistence to JSON and query capabilities.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.name: KnowledgeGraph
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.docstring: In-memory graph database and JSON serializer for code repository structure.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.add_no.name: KnowledgeGraph.add_node
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.add_no.docstring: Adds or updates a node in the graph.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.add_ed.name: KnowledgeGraph.add_edge
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.add_ed.docstring: Adds a directed edge between two nodes.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.save.name: KnowledgeGraph.save
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.save.docstring: Persists the graph to a JSON file.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.load.name: KnowledgeGraph.load
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.load.docstring: Loads a graph from a JSON file.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.query.name: KnowledgeGraph.query
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.query.docstring: Searches nodes by matching query terms against node ID, name, path, or docstring.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.get_de.name: KnowledgeGraph.get_dependencies
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.get_de.docstring: Returns a list of module IDs imported by the given module.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.get_de.name: KnowledgeGraph.get_dependents
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.get_de.docstring: Returns a list of module IDs that import the given module.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph._resol.name: KnowledgeGraph._resolve_module_id
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph._resol.docstring: Resolves a module name, path, or ID to a valid node ID in the graph.

graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.get_st.name: KnowledgeGraph.get_stats
graphify/graph.py::KnowledgeGraph.get_st.docstring: Returns statistics of the indexed knowledge graph.

graphify/server.py.name: graphify.server
graphify/server.py.docstring:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server for Graphify.
Exposes AST code indexer, query search, and dependency tools to AI agents
using FastMCP (if available) or lightweight stdio JSON-RPC fallback.

graphify/server.py::_tool_extract.name: _tool_extract
graphify/server.py::_tool_extract.docstring: Regenera el grafo cognitivo del repositorio analizando los archivos Python por AST.

graphify/server.py::_tool_query.name: _tool_query
graphify/server.py::_tool_query.docstring: Busca en el grafo del conocimiento nodos coincidentes en nombre, ruta o docstring.

graphify/server.py::_tool_dependencies.name: _tool_dependencies
graphify/server.py::_tool_dependencies.docstring: Lista qué módulos y librerías son importados (dependencias directas) por un archivo o módulo.

graphify/server.py::_tool_dependents.name: _tool_dependents
graphify/server.py::_tool_dependents.docstring: Lista qué archivos y módulos del proyecto dependen de un módulo dado (dependientes inversos).

graphify/server.py::graphify_extract.name: graphify_extract
graphify/server.py::graphify_extract.docstring: Regenerate the repository AST knowledge graph.

graphify/server.py::graphify_query.name: graphify_query
graphify/server.py::graphify_query.docstring: Search the repository graph by term or keyword.

graphify/server.py::graphify_dependencie.name: graphify_dependencies
graphify/server.py::graphify_dependencie.docstring: List internal modules imported by the specified module.

graphify/server.py::graphify_dependents.name: graphify_dependents
graphify/server.py::graphify_dependents.docstring: List internal modules that import the specified module.

graphify/__init__.py.name: graphify
graphify/__init__.py.docstring:
Graphify Knowledge Graph & MCP Server Engine.
Indexes Python codebase via AST, constructs relational knowledge graph, and serves AI agents.

graphify/__main__.py.name: graphify.__main__
graphify/__main__.py.docstring:
Command-line interface (CLI) entry point for Graphify.
Supports 'extract', 'query', and 'serve' commands.

scripts/run_paper_trading.py.name: scripts.run_paper_trading
scripts/run_paper_trading.py.docstring:
Live Paper Trading Runner Script.
Executes continuous real-time Paper Trading loop with Multi-Timeframe (MTF) features,
ATR Risk Budgeting leverage, Pyramiding position scaling, and Telegram push alerts.

scripts/run_preprod_stress_test.py.name: scripts.run_preprod_stress_test
scripts/run_preprod_stress_test.py.docstring:
Quantitative Pre-Production Stress-Test & Backtest Gatekeeper.

Simulates 1,000 synthetic crypto candles across extreme volatility regimes
(bull run, flash crash shock, high-vol consolidation) applying:
- Calibrated continuous signals in [-1.0, +1.0]
- Maker Fee 0.020% & Slippage 0.010%
- Fractional Kelly position sizing capped at HARD_MAX_LEVERAGE
- Bracket OCO Take-Profit and Stop-Loss orders
- Financial Metrics evaluation (Sharpe, Sortino, Max Drawdown, Profit Factor)

scripts/run_preprod_stress_test.py::gene.name: generate_stress_scenario
scripts/run_preprod_stress_test.py::gene.docstring:
Generates realistic synthetic 4-hour OHLCV candles with regime shifts:
0-300: Bullish trend with moderate volatility
300-500: Flash crash / severe drawdown shock (-25% drop)
500-1000: High volatility sideways mean-reversion regime

scripts/update_knowledge_graph.py.name: scripts.update_knowledge_graph
scripts/update_knowledge_graph.py.docstring:
MLOps Automation Script: Update Graphify Knowledge Graph.
Extracts AST structure of repository and refreshes .graphify/graph.json.

scripts/validate_env.py.name: scripts.validate_env
scripts/validate_env.py.docstring:
MLOps Environment Validator Script.
Audits required environment variables for Dev, QA, and Production profiles
without printing sensitive API secrets to console logs.

src/api/server.py.name: src.api.server
src/api/server.py.docstring:
FastAPI Server for Real-Time Trading Signals Inference (REST & WebSocket).
Provides /health, /predict REST endpoints and /ws/signals WebSocket streaming.
Includes Hard Circuit Breakers, Leverage Cap Enforcements & Telegram Push Alerts.

src/api/server.py::get_performance_metri.name: get_performance_metrics
src/api/server.py::get_performance_metri.docstring: Returns active quantitative performance metrics for the Streamlit dashboard.

src/api/server.py::get_dashboard_stats.name: get_dashboard_stats
src/api/server.py::get_dashboard_stats.docstring: Returns paper trading equity curve history and recent transaction log.

src/api/server.py::reload_model_in_memor.name: reload_model_in_memory
src/api/server.py::reload_model_in_memor.docstring: Zero-Downtime Hot-Reloading endpoint: Reloads trained .joblib model in API memory without restart.

src/api/server.py::predict_signal.name: predict_signal
src/api/server.py::predict_signal.docstring:
Computes features, evaluates signal score in [-1.0, +1.0] and calculates TP/SL levels.
Enforces Hard Circuit Breakers, Hard Leverage Cap and triggers Telegram Alerts for strong signals.

src/api/server.py::websocket_signals_end.name: websocket_signals_endpoint
src/api/server.py::websocket_signals_end.docstring: Streaming WebSocket endpoint broadcasting periodic signal updates with Hard Circuit Breakers.

src/backtest/engine.py.name: src.backtest.engine
src/backtest/engine.py.docstring:
Vectorized & Event-Driven Backtesting Engine.
Simulates explicit Leverage (Nx), Margin Maintenance, Liquidation Prices (P_liq),
Taker/Maker fees on notional value, and slippage.

src/backtest/engine.py::run_leverage_bac.name: run_leverage_backtest
src/backtest/engine.py::run_leverage_bac.docstring:
Executes vectorized backtest from continuous signal [-1.0, +1.0] with explicit Leverage and Liquidation simulation.

Parameters:
    df: Polars DataFrame containing prices.
    leverage: Max leverage multiplier (e.g., 3.0x, 5.0x, 10.0x).
    signal_threshold: Minimum absolute signal magnitude to open position.
    taker_fee: Fee charged on NOTIONAL trade volume.
    slippage: Execution price slippage penalty.
    maintenance_margin_rate: Exchange Maintenance Margin Rate (MMR).
    initial_capital: Starting portfolio balance in USDT.

src/backtest/metrics.py.name: src.backtest.metrics
src/backtest/metrics.py.docstring:
Quantitative Financial Metrics Module for Backtesting.
Includes Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, Max Drawdown, Calmar Ratio, and Profit Factor.

src/backtest/metrics.py::calculate_sorti.name: calculate_sortino_ratio
src/backtest/metrics.py::calculate_sorti.docstring: Calculates Annualized Sortino Ratio (downside risk only).

src/backtest/metrics.py::calculate_profi.name: calculate_profit_factor
src/backtest/metrics.py::calculate_profi.docstring: Calculates Profit Factor (Gross Profits / Gross Losses).

src/backtest/metrics.py::calculate_calma.name: calculate_calmar_ratio
src/backtest/metrics.py::calculate_calma.docstring: Calculates Calmar Ratio (Annualized Return / Max Drawdown).

src/dashboard/app.py.name: src.dashboard.app
src/dashboard/app.py.docstring:
Streamlit Visual Monitoring Dashboard for Trading Signals ML.
Visualizes real-time continuous signal [-1.0, +1.0], equity curve PnL,
1d macro trend status, and concept drift metrics.

src/data/cleaning.py.name: src.data.cleaning
src/data/cleaning.py.docstring: Data cleaning, validation, and Information Bars sampling module.

src/data/cleaning.py::clean_ohlcv_data.name: clean_ohlcv_data
src/data/cleaning.py::clean_ohlcv_data.docstring: Cleans OHLCV DataFrame by removing nulls, zero volumes, and duplicate timestamps.

src/data/cleaning.py::compute_dynamic_do.name: compute_dynamic_dollar_bar_threshold
src/data/cleaning.py::compute_dynamic_do.docstring:
Computes a dynamic, context-adaptive Dollar Bar threshold based on the rolling mean
of daily dollar volume divided by the target bar frequency (~24 bars/day).
Prevents time-varying sample imbalance across multi-year market regimes.

src/data/cleaning.py::resample_to_inform.name: resample_to_information_bars
src/data/cleaning.py::resample_to_inform.docstring:
Resamples chronological OHLCV data into Information Bars (Dollar Bars or Volume Bars).
Supports dynamic context-adaptive threshold calculation.

Parameters:
    df: Polars DataFrame containing OHLCV.
    threshold: Explicit Dollar or Volume threshold. If None and auto_dynamic_threshold=True, computed dynamically.
    bar_type: 'dollar' (Notional Value = Close * Volume) or 'volume' (Shares/Units Volume).
    auto_dynamic_threshold: Whether to compute threshold dynamically if threshold is None.

src/data/ingestion.py.name: src.data.ingestion
src/data/ingestion.py.docstring:
Data ingestion module for OHLCV and crypto microstructure data (Funding Rate, Open Interest).
Uses CCXT and yfinance with robust fallback handlers.

src/data/ingestion.py::fetch_ohlcv_yfina.name: fetch_ohlcv_yfinance
src/data/ingestion.py::fetch_ohlcv_yfina.docstring:
Fetches historical OHLCV data from Yahoo Finance and converts it to a Polars DataFrame.
Includes synthetic fallback generator for offline / rate-limited execution.

src/data/ingestion.py::fetch_microstruct.name: fetch_microstructure_data
src/data/ingestion.py::fetch_microstruct.docstring:
Fetches microstructural data (Funding Rate & Open Interest).
Includes synthetic baseline generator for deterministic offline backtesting.

src/data/ingestion.py::fetch_multi_year_.name: fetch_multi_year_dataset
src/data/ingestion.py::fetch_multi_year_.docstring: Unified multi-year data ingestion pipeline ensuring multi-regime coverage (bull, bear, range).

src/execution/ccxt_executor.py.name: src.execution.ccxt_executor
src/execution/ccxt_executor.py.docstring:
CCXT Private API Direct Exchange Execution Adapter.
Supports Binance Futures and Bybit Futures with Testnet / Live key handling.
Enforces Hard Circuit Breakers and Bracket TP/SL Order placement.

src/execution/ccxt_executor.py::Exchange.name: ExchangeExecutor
src/execution/ccxt_executor.py::Exchange.docstring: Direct Exchange Execution Adapter connecting to Binance/Bybit Futures APIs.

src/execution/ccxt_executor.py::Exchange.name: ExchangeExecutor._initialize_exchange
src/execution/ccxt_executor.py::Exchange.docstring: Initializes CCXT private exchange instance with testnet sandbox support.

src/execution/ccxt_executor.py::Exchange.name: ExchangeExecutor.execute_signal_order
src/execution/ccxt_executor.py::Exchange.docstring:
Executes leverage configuration, main position order (Maker Limit Order by default),
and bracket TP/SL orders on the exchange.

src/execution/paper_trader.py.name: src.execution.paper_trader
src/execution/paper_trader.py.docstring:
Paper Trading Dry-Run Engine.
Simulates live signal execution, latency metrics, paper balance tracking, and trade logging.

src/execution/paper_trader.py::PaperTrad.name: PaperTraderEngine
src/execution/paper_trader.py::PaperTrad.docstring: Dry-run simulation engine for live signal testing on Testnet/Paper accounts.

src/execution/paper_trader.py::PaperTrad.name: PaperTraderEngine.process_signal
src/execution/paper_trader.py::PaperTrad.docstring:
Processes a live signal update and executes virtual paper trades.
Evaluates bracket TP/SL touches and applies 0.020% Maker Fee on entries and exits.

src/execution/__init__.py.name: src.execution
src/execution/__init__.py.docstring:
Execution Package.
Includes Paper Trading Dry-Run Engine.

src/features/technical_indicators.py.name: src.features.technical_indicators
src/features/technical_indicators.py.docstring:
Advanced Feature Engineering Module using Polars.
Includes Fractional Differentiation (FracDiff d*), Crypto Microstructure Indicators,
Multi-Timeframe trends, and strict Zero Look-Ahead Bias via .shift(1).

src/features/technical_indicators.py::ge.name: get_fracdiff_weights
src/features/technical_indicators.py::ge.docstring: Generates Fractional Differentiation weights (López de Prado).

src/features/technical_indicators.py::fr.name: fractional_differentiation
src/features/technical_indicators.py::fr.docstring: Applies Fractional Differentiation to a 1D numpy array.

src/features/technical_indicators.py::fi.name: find_optimal_d
src/features/technical_indicators.py::fi.docstring:
Finds minimum exponent d* in [0.0, 1.0] that passes ADF stationarity test (p-value < 0.05).
If train_ratio is provided, calibrates strictly on the initial training window to avoid look-ahead bias.

src/features/technical_indicators.py::ad.name: add_advanced_features
src/features/technical_indicators.py::ad.docstring:
Computes comprehensive quantitative features using Polars vectorized expressions.
All features enforce .shift(1) to guarantee zero look-ahead bias.

src/features/technical_indicators.py::ad.name: add_multi_timeframe_features
src/features/technical_indicators.py::ad.docstring:
Integrates Multi-Timeframe (MTF) indicators (1d Macro Trend, 4h Volatility Regime) onto the 1h baseline.
Enforces strict .shift(1) and Polars join_asof(strategy='backward') to eliminate look-ahead bias.

src/models/ensemble.py.name: src.models.ensemble
src/models/ensemble.py.docstring:
Hybrid Multi-Model Ensemble Module.
Blends predictions from LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost classifiers.
Calculates dynamic weighted ensemble probabilities:
P_ensemble = w_lgb * P_lgb + w_xgb * P_xgb + w_cat * P_cat

src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.name: HybridEnsembleClassifier
src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.docstring: Ensemble Classifier combining LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost.

src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.name: HybridEnsembleClassifier.fit
src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.docstring:
Fits all 3 models on the feature matrix.
Maps labels {-1, 0, 1} to non-negative range for XGBoost {0, 1, 2}.

src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.name: HybridEnsembleClassifier.fit_dynamic_weights
src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.docstring:
Dynamically adjusts model weights proportional to Out-of-Sample (OOS) accuracy performance.
Formula: w_m = Accuracy_m / sum(Accuracy_k)

src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.name: HybridEnsembleClassifier.predict_proba
src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.docstring: Returns blended class probabilities P(Buy) and P(Sell).

src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.name: HybridEnsembleClassifier.predict
src/models/ensemble.py::HybridEnsembleCl.docstring: Standard sklearn/lgbm compatible predict method returning predicted side {-1, +1}.

src/models/meta_labeling.py.name: src.models.meta_labeling
src/models/meta_labeling.py.docstring:
Meta-Labeling Module (López de Prado Framework).
Combines Primary Model side prediction with Secondary Meta-Model confidence filtering.

src/models/meta_labeling.py::MetaLabelin.name: MetaLabelingPipeline
src/models/meta_labeling.py::MetaLabelin.docstring:
Two-stage architecture:
1. Primary Model predicts market side m_t in {-1, +1} (Long/Short).
2. Meta Model predicts probability P(meta = 1) that primary prediction succeeds.

src/models/meta_labeling.py::MetaLabelin.name: MetaLabelingPipeline.fit
src/models/meta_labeling.py::MetaLabelin.docstring: Fits Primary Model on triple barrier labels {-1, 0, +1} and Meta-Model on binary success labels {0, 1}.

src/models/meta_labeling.py::MetaLabelin.name: MetaLabelingPipeline.predict_confidence

src/models/optimize.py.name: src.models.optimize
src/models/optimize.py.docstring:
Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization Module using Optuna (Per-Asset Tuning).
Optimizes Sortino Ratio Out-of-Sample while constraining Max Drawdown < 15%.

src/models/optimize.py::optimize_asset_p.name: optimize_asset_parameters
src/models/optimize.py::optimize_asset_p.docstring:
Executes Optuna study to find optimal asset parameters for (pt_multiplier, sl_multiplier, FracDiff d*).

Parameters:
    df_raw: Raw OHLCV DataFrame for the asset.
    symbol: Trading pair name.
    n_trials: Number of Bayesian search iterations.
    
Returns:
    Best parameter dictionary and objective value.

src/models/optuna_tuner.py.name: src.models.optuna_tuner
src/models/optuna_tuner.py.docstring:
Optuna Hyperparameter Optimization Module.
Performs Bayesian optimization targeting Out-of-Sample Sharpe Ratio
over Purged Walk-Forward Cross-Validation splits.

src/models/optuna_tuner.py::objective_sh.name: objective_sharpe_ratio
src/models/optuna_tuner.py::objective_sh.docstring: Optuna objective function maximizing Out-of-Sample Sharpe Ratio over Purged CV splits.

src/models/optuna_tuner.py::tune_model_h.name: tune_model_hyperparameters
src/models/optuna_tuner.py::tune_model_h.docstring: Executes Optuna Bayesian hyperparameter tuning targeting Out-of-Sample Sharpe Ratio.

src/models/signal_scaler.py.name: src.models.signal_scaler
src/models/signal_scaler.py.docstring:
Signal Scaler & Bet Sizing Module.
Converts model predictions and meta-labeling probabilities into a continuous signal bounded in [-1.0, +1.0].
Applies Modified Kelly Bet Sizing scaling.

src/models/signal_scaler.py::scale_proba.name: scale_probabilities_to_signal
src/models/signal_scaler.py::scale_proba.docstring:
Scales class probabilities into a continuous signal in range [-1.0, +1.0].
Formula: Signal = prob_buy - prob_sell

src/models/signal_scaler.py::apply_macro.name: apply_macro_trend_filter
src/models/signal_scaler.py::apply_macro.docstring:
Enforces the Strict Daily Macro Trend Filter (1d):
- If 1d Macro Regime is Bearish (-1.0), Long signals (S_t > 0) are blocked (set to 0.0).
- If 1d Macro Regime is Bullish (+1.0), Short signals (S_t < 0) are blocked (set to 0.0).

src/models/signal_scaler.py::scale_meta_.name: scale_meta_signal
src/models/signal_scaler.py::scale_meta_.docstring:
Scales combined side predictions {-1, +1} and Meta-Model confidence P(meta) in [0, 1]
into a continuous signal in range [-1.0, +1.0].
Enforces the Strict Daily Macro Trend Filter (1d) if macro_regime_1d is supplied.

src/models/signal_scaler.py::calculate_f.name: calculate_fractional_kelly_bet_size
src/models/signal_scaler.py::calculate_f.docstring:
Calculates Fractional Kelly Criterion Bet Size.
Formula: f* = (p * b - (1 - p)) / b
Scaled by fractional multiplier (e.g. Half-Kelly 0.50) for capital preservation.

src/models/signal_scaler.py::scale_regre.name: scale_regression_return_to_signal
src/models/signal_scaler.py::scale_regre.docstring:
Scales predicted continuous returns into a signal in [-1.0, +1.0] using hyperbolic tangent.
Formula: Signal = tanh( predicted_returns / (factor * volatility) )

src/models/train.py.name: src.models.train
src/models/train.py.docstring:
Model Training & Purged Walk-Forward Cross-Validation Module.
Guarantees anti-leakage with Embargo and Sample Uniqueness weighting.

src/models/train.py::purged_walk_forward.name: purged_walk_forward_splits
src/models/train.py::purged_walk_forward.docstring: Generates Purged Walk-Forward temporal splits with Embargo to eliminate data leakage.

src/models/train.py::train_model_pipelin.name: train_model_pipeline
src/models/train.py::train_model_pipelin.docstring:
Executes complete ML training pipeline:
1. Triple Barrier Labeling
2. Sample Uniqueness Weights computation (normalized strictly per fold)
3. Purged Walk-Forward CV with Dynamic OOS Ensemble Weighting
4. Meta-Labeling training

src/models/triple_barrier.py.name: src.models.triple_barrier
src/models/triple_barrier.py.docstring:
Triple Barrier Labeling Module (López de Prado Method).
Computes dynamic Take Profit, Stop Loss, and Time Expiration barriers for Longs and Shorts.

src/models/triple_barrier.py::apply_trip.name: apply_triple_barrier_labeling
src/models/triple_barrier.py::apply_trip.docstring:
Applies the Triple Barrier Method to create symmetric labels for Long (+1) and Short (-1).
Supports Dynamic Context-Adaptive Volatility Scaling (scaling TP/SL by short/long vol ratio).

Parameters:
    df: Polars DataFrame containing 'close' and 'feature_volatility_20' (or ATR proxy).
    pt_multiplier: Take Profit ATR multiplier scalar.
    sl_multiplier: Stop Loss ATR multiplier scalar.
    vertical_barrier_lags: Number of max bars allowed before expiration.
    dynamic_volatility_scaling: If True, scales multipliers by local volatility regime.
    
Returns:
    DataFrame with attached 'label' column in {-1, 0, +1}.

src/models/triple_barrier.py::compute_sa.name: compute_sample_uniqueness_weights
src/models/triple_barrier.py::compute_sa.docstring:
Computes Sample Uniqueness weights (w_t) according to López de Prado.
Prevents concurrent overlapping events from over-influencing tree splits.

src/monitoring/drift.py.name: src.monitoring.drift
src/monitoring/drift.py.docstring:
Concept Drift Detection Module.
Monitors feature distribution shifts using Kolmogorov-Smirnov test to adjust leverage automatically.

src/monitoring/drift.py::ConceptDriftDet.name: ConceptDriftDetector
src/monitoring/drift.py::ConceptDriftDet.docstring: Evaluates feature drift between baseline training set and live production window.

src/monitoring/drift.py::ConceptDriftDet.name: ConceptDriftDetector.fit_baseline
src/monitoring/drift.py::ConceptDriftDet.docstring: Stores baseline distributions from training dataset.

src/monitoring/drift.py::ConceptDriftDet.name: ConceptDriftDetector.detect_drift
src/monitoring/drift.py::ConceptDriftDet.docstring:
Runs 2-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test on current window features.
Returns drift status and suggested leverage multiplier reduction.

src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py.name: src.monitoring.telegram_bot
src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py.docstring:
Telegram Bot Notification Module.
Dispatches real-time signal alerts, TP/SL levels, leverage recommendations,
and Circuit Breaker warnings via Telegram Bot API (No-Cost).

src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.name: TelegramNotifier
src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.docstring:
Asynchronous Telegram Notifier for real-time trading signals and risk alerts.
Gracefully falls back to log-only mode if credentials are not configured.

src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.name: TelegramNotifier.send_message_async
src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.docstring: Sends an asynchronous text message to Telegram.

src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.name: TelegramNotifier.send_signal_alert_sync
src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.docstring:
Formats and dispatches a structured signal alert synchronously.
Supports Rolling Z-Score Alert evaluation and MTF macro trend context.

src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.name: TelegramNotifier.send_circuit_breaker_alert_sync
src/monitoring/telegram_bot.py::Telegram.docstring: Formats and dispatches an emergency circuit breaker alert.

src/pipeline/retrain.py.name: src.pipeline.retrain
src/pipeline/retrain.py.docstring:
Automated MLOps Retraining Pipeline.
Fetches recent multi-year data, evaluates Concept Drift, re-trains model pipeline,
and exports atomic .joblib model artifacts for Zero-Downtime Hot-Reloading.

src/pipeline/retrain.py::run_automated_r.name: run_automated_retraining_pipeline
src/pipeline/retrain.py::run_automated_r.docstring: Executes automated retraining pipeline with Concept Drift validation and Atomic Hot-Reloading.

src/pipeline/__init__.py.name: src.pipeline
src/pipeline/__init__.py.docstring:
